name: Futanari♪ Milk Seeki
original_name: ふたなり♪ミルクセーぇキ
source:
Two futanari sister-in-law live peacefully together with a cute boy till the day he learns their secret in the bath. Their unusual fun and naughty life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两个扶他嫂子和一个可爱的男孩和平地生活在一起，直到有一天他在浴室里得知了她们的秘密。他们不同寻常的有趣和顽皮的生活开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
